_doc: Reproducible measured-LUFS balance for a tight/focused/DRY/punchy 1970s drum bus from the phase-aligned multi-mic kit. Fully dry = room mic OUT, snare-top bleed-gated, overheads hat-cancelled, no plate. Levels are set by integrated LUFS (NOT eyeballed/RMS/peak-normalized) — overhead sits ~7 LU UNDER the kick so cymbals/hat don't dominate. Feed this to scripts/mix/balance_stems.py, then shape_bands (punch), then presets/vst/tight-70s-dry.json (tone). Built 2026-05-31.

downstream.punch: shape_bands crossovers [120,2500]; low transient +0.4, mid transient +0.5 gain -1, high transient +0.4 gain +0.5
